    Support Human Relief Nepal

    Your support can help communities move forward.

    Support Human Relief Nepal’s humanitarian and development work. Contact our team to ask about current project needs and available donation options.

    Ask How to Donate Contact Us

    How your donation reaches families

    1. Choose a project

      Pick a project, or give where the need is greatest.

    2. Transfer with a reference

      Send to an official account below, with your name and the project in the reference.

    3. Message us, we confirm

      Send us a message after the transfer. We confirm it, record it under that project, and our team in Nepal delivers the support.

    4. See the progress

      Follow our field updates, or ask us for a report.
